horizon_driver: Governor Ueda's term runs to 2028; the binding clock is really Japan's debt-service feedback loop (>250% debt/GDP) which shortens the effective horizon every time the policy rate rises, plus rising domestic political pressure over yen weakness and cost-of-living inflation.

capabilities.meaning: pause the hiking cycle at current levels
a scheduled 25bp hike or coordinated signal with MOF on JGB market management
a larger or unscheduled hike, or accelerated QT that risks JGB market dysfunction / triggers a disorderly carry-trade unwind

constraints.source: financial-stability co-mandate and legacy yield-curve-control instincts
constraints.breaks_under: sustained imported inflation forces hikes even as JGB yields hit multi-decade highs — already observed: 2Y JGB at 1.83% (highest since 1995), 10Y at 2.99% as of Sept 11 2026, with hikes continuing

constraints.source: Japan's debt/GDP ratio makes BOJ's own rate hikes a direct driver of government interest costs
constraints.breaks_under: not yet broken; hikes remain incremental (25bp steps) rather than large moves, consistent with ongoing MOF coordination

constraints.source: BOJ's communication doctrine emphasizes predictability after the Aug 2024 carry-trade shock
constraints.breaks_under: the Aug 2024 episode itself is the documented violation — the doctrine is aspirational, not proven durable

stated_vs_revealed.stated: BOJ doctrine holds normalization will proceed gradually and cautiously, contingent on a sustainable 2% inflation trajectory anchored by wage growth ('no preset path').
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: Since the policy rate reached 0.50% in January 2025, the BOJ has hiked in a compressed cadence to 1% by June 2026 — the highest since 1995 — and is weighing a further hike at the 17-18 September 2026 meeting (market-implied probability ~62%), with Governor Ueda stating hikes are 'on the table at every meeting.' The proximate driver is producer-price inflation of 7.6% YoY in August 2026 and a weak yen amplified by Middle East conflict-driven energy costs, not the domestic wage-driven virtuous cycle the mandate emphasizes.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: The pace of normalization is the fastest of the post-1990s era and is being driven by imported/FX-transmitted inflation, not by the domestic demand-pull story BOJ communications foreground. Treat the 'gradual, wage-driven' framing as aspirational messaging around a reaction function that is actually FX- and energy-shock-sensitive.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: BOJ presents financial-market stability and orderly transmission as a co-equal concern alongside price stability.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: The BOJ has continued signaling and delivering hikes through 2025-26 even as the yen carry trade (estimated ~$261bn) continues unwinding and JGB yields hit multi-decade highs, without pausing the cycle to protect carry-trade-exposed positions in crypto, EM bonds, or leveraged equities.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: When price stability (via the FX/imported-inflation channel) and financial-stability caution conflict, price stability wins in practice. The 'co-equal concern' framing understates how far behind it actually ranks once inflation data forces the issue.

tripwires.if: core or producer inflation stays elevated with a weak yen persisting
tripwires.then: BOJ hikes again regardless of carry-trade stress (observed pattern through 2025-26)

tripwires.if: a disorderly JGB auction or 10Y yield spikes past roughly 3.2-3.5%
tripwires.then: BOJ intervenes or slows QT to preserve market function — untested in this cycle but consistent with past yield-curve-control instincts

tripwires.if: USD/JPY weakens sharply past a fresh multi-decade extreme
tripwires.then: domestic political pressure on the BOJ to hike accelerates independent of the regular data calendar

what_would_change_my_mind: An explicit BOJ pause or reversal citing financial stability over inflation control would show the financial-stability weight is actually higher than currently revealed; a repeat unscheduled shock hike would confirm the Aug 2024 pattern is a durable feature, not an anomaly.
